title: Windows-safe Node module path resolution for Staging preflight contracts

phases.objective: Keep the read-only Windows Staging schema/governance preflight executable on Node.js 22 by resolving repository paths from import.meta.dirname instead of URL pathname text that misrepresents Windows drive-letter paths.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The schema/governance preflight can execute the One-Click Node contract from a drive-letter checkout such as M:\... without node:fs ENOENT caused by /M:/ URL pathname conversion, while all existing fail-closed checks remain active.
steps: Bootstrap verifies exact HEAD and first-parent history before schema governance preflight.
The contract derives repository root from import.meta.dirname and reads tracked Staging files using native Windows filesystem paths.
The regression contract rejects reintroduction of import.meta.url pathname path construction for the One-Click contract.
assertions: No database, migration, grant, Docker schema apply, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, or Production mutation is performed by this change.
No credentials or secrets are read into evidence or printed.
Existing exact-SHA, clean-worktree, origin-identity, first-parent, and fail-closed preflight authority remains unchanged.
The fix is limited to cross-platform filesystem path resolution and its regression coverage.

phases.objective: This change grants no Production deployment, provider mutation, credential access, or production_live authority.
blockers: Production actions require separate explicit authorization and independent evidence.
Live Staging certification remains required after this Staging-impacting change is merged and deployed.
